title: Bachelor Nanny
description: The story of a single guy who, after agreeing to take in his sister’s twin newborns, has to juggle babies and babes.
quote: Am I going crazy or are those two babies?
altHero: Dieter Dalmer in a tan suit and scraggly blonde hair, next to two non-toddler kids dressed as babies in a crib
alt2: Lavetrious Kennedy in a colorful 80s sweater and pointing
alt3: Dieter Dalmer in a robe, opening the door for a woman in a robe
